title: SYNAPSE experiment platform: cognitive experiments in the browser
description:
SYNAPSE (Synergistic Neurophysiological Assessment of Perception in Sensory Environments) experiment platform: an open, browser-based application for cognitive experiments. It combines established task paradigms (n-back, Stroop, flanker, visual counting and shape comparison), questionnaires, rest baselines and soundscapes in one session; an experiment designer with templates, practice trials, feedback and counterbalancing; shareable protocol files; and local CSV/JSON export. No server is required and no participant data leave the computer.

The built-in protocol reproduces the session of the SYNAPSE study (Technical University of Denmark, June 2025). Live version: https://synapse.ptomar.com.
